raw_html: [[Alchemical Attunement|Alchemical Water Attunement]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]][[Alchemical Attunement|'''Alchemical Water Attunement:''']] Attacks and offensive spells have a chance to inflict ten stacks of cold damage over time, fading one stack at a time. This effect has an internal cooldown.
